title: Missing moeb tool: Bash
description: Used Bash (3 calls: cargo test -p moeb, cargo build --release) during the Verify phase. No moeb equivalent exists for executing shell commands in the project.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb tool (e.g., run_command) that executes shell commands from the working directory, enabling cargo test and cargo build within the moeb tool-call boundary.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: Used Read (3 calls) to read the start_run MCP tool result saved to the Claude project directory when output exceeded the inline token limit. No moeb equivalent exists for reading files outside the working directory.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool (e.g. read_tool_result) that accepts a saved tool result path and returns it in paginated chunks, eliminating external Read calls on oversized tool outputs.

title: Spec behavior change conflicts with no-test-regression rubric
description: Step 3 of moeb.patch-file-removed-line-diagnostic changes the error message for the case where all context lines are present but a removed line is absent. The existing test patch_file_diagnostic_all_present_when_context_found asserts the old 'All context lines appear' message, which now routes to the new 'removed lines not in file' branch. The spec requires both the three-branch handler (Step 3) and no test file modification (no-test-regression rubric), but these cannot be satisfied simultaneously. The test was updated to keep all 216 tests passing.
proposed_resolution: When authoring specs that change error message behavior, explicitly identify which existing tests will need assertion updates and include the required changes in the Steps section to avoid the no-test-regression conflict.
